device.name: IKA RCT digital 5 hotplate and magnetic stirrer (Minerva RCTDigital5)

facts.text: The class controls an IKA RCT digital 5 hotplate over a serial COM port

The module names the NAMUR commands: IN_NAME for the device name, IN_PV_1 and IN_PV_2 for the external and hotplate temperatures, IN_PV_4 for the stirring speed, IN_PV_5 for the viscosity trend, and IN_SP_1, IN_SP_3 and IN_SP_4 for the setpoints
The external thermocouple temperature is reported in degrees Celsius
The hotplate temperature is reported in degrees Celsius
The stirring speed is reported in rpm
The temperature setpoint is reported in degrees Celsius
The safety temperature is reported in degrees Celsius
The stirring speed setpoint is reported in rpm
The comment on READ_SAFETY_TEMPERATURE_VALUE says the target/set temperature may be 50 degrees beneath the safety temperature
start_heating sets the temperature setpoint first when a value is given, then sends the start-heating command
stop_heating switches the heating off and, with its default reset_setpoint=True, sets the temperature setpoint to 0 degrees Celsius
stop_stirring switches the stirring off and, with its default reset_setpoint=True, sets the stirring setpoint to 0 rpm
emergency_stop sets EMERGENCY_STOP_REQUEST and calls stop_heating and stop_stirring
Commands and responses are terminated with CR LF
The constructor prefixes a port with COM when the argument does not already start with COM
